svg.title: Akhoilaw Shrine Ship - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 86-87, PDF 87-88. Combined envelope follows larger Deck 1, with tapered flat forward bridge, broad rounded shrine body and narrow exposed aft drive. Smaller Deck 2 is contained within it. Illustration corroborates broad central body and short forward ramp; illustrated rear fins omitted from plan-based envelope with span unspecified.
